repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(not (all(#ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == false))
triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == false)
all(#Switch).switch_on()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the condition at the start of the wrapper period using an `if` statement. The IR requires a rising-edge wait, meaning the action must fire immediately when the condition transitions to true, even if that happens mid-period. The candidate fails to observe this transition because it only checks the state at the beginning of the iteration.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a blocking `wait until` for the rising edge. This ensures the script suspends until the contact sensor goes false, then executes the switch action, and finally sets the `triggered` flag to prevent re-firing while the condition remains false. This matches the IR's rising-edge semantics.
